plugins.name: Files Studio
plugins.description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other OpenDAL services.

versions.releaseNotes: 新增 Google Cloud Storage、Azure Blob、华为 OBS，以及阿里云盘、Dropbox、Google Drive、Koofr、OneDrive、pCloud、Seafile、Yandex Disk 等 OpenDAL 云存储服务，并同步扩充连接表单契约与协议矩阵测试。Adds Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, Huawei OBS, plus Alibaba Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Koofr, OneDrive, pCloud, Seafile, and Yandex Disk, with expanded connection-form and protocol-matrix coverage.

发布者身份与命名统一：插件 manifest 的 publisher 对齐 dbx-store 发布者 jinpy，各语言显示名统一为 Files Studio（中文不再显示「DBX 文件」）。Identity and naming alignment: the manifest publisher now matches the verified dbx-store publisher (jinpy), and every localized display name is unified as Files Studio.

首个商店版本：统一文件工作台，多协议引擎覆盖本地 fs、S3/MinIO、阿里云 OSS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP（双栈）、SMB/CIFS；支持浏览、上传下载、复制移动、传输任务（进度/取消/历史）、zip 归档压缩解压、目录同步、presigned 公开链接、只读与删除保护，以及面向自动化的 MCP 工具接口。First store release: unified multi-backend file workspace with transfers, archives, sync, presigned links, read-only/delete guards, and a 12-tool MCP surface.

plugins.name: Kafka Studio
plugins.description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.

versions.releaseNotes: 修复深色主题下 Topic 侧栏不可读的问题：图标色随 color-scheme 自动翻转，核心颜色令牌改为实时跟随宿主主题（不再被内联快照冻结），并提升树行/星标对比度。消息查询新增「最近 N 条」Offset 策略并设为默认：原「最新」策略从日志末端只等待新消息，对没有持续流量的 topic 总是「已扫描 0 · 命中 0」，现在默认即可读到每个分区最新的历史记录。Fixed topics sidebar legibility in dark theme: icon hues follow color-scheme, core color tokens now track the host theme live instead of being frozen by an inline snapshot, and tree row/star contrast was raised. Messages query adds a recent-N offset strategy and defaults to it: the previous latest default only waited for new records and always scanned zero on idle topics; the new default surfaces the newest existing records per partition.

修复 DBX 隧道/代理下的 Kafka 连接：插件改为拨宿主下发的最终端点 runtime.host:port，并在宿主下发 runtime.proxy 时让所有 broker（含 advertised.listeners 发现的）共用同一个 SOCKS5 dialer，admin/生产/一次性消费/流式消费一致生效；代理路径补齐 TLS 握手与按 broker 的 SNI。消费组 offset 重置修复 Kafka 4.x 误报成功的问题（OffsetCommit v10 起以 topic id 标识主题，旧提交被 broker 以 UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID 拒绝），任一分区被拒即返回错误。Fixes Kafka connections behind DBX transport/proxy layers: the sidecar now dials the host-provided runtime endpoint and, when the host publishes runtime.proxy, routes every broker (including brokers discovered via advertised.listeners) through one SOCKS5 dialer shared by admin, produce, one-shot consume and stream clients, with the TLS handshake and per-broker SNI applied after the proxy CONNECT. Consumer-group offset reset now commits by topic id for Kafka 4.x (OffsetCommit v10+) instead of being rejected as UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID and misreported as success.

首个商店版本（Kafka Studio）：在一个 DBX 工作台中管理 Apache Kafka——topic/分区/消费组巡检、消息生产与消费（本地聚合 digest、cursor 翻页与流式导出）、消费组 lag 监控与受控 offset 重置、topic/ACL 运维，支持 PLAINTEXT/TLS/SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）、Kerberos、OAUTHBEARER 与 Confluent/AWS Glue Schema Registry；工作台界面提供 7 种语言（en/zh-CN/zh-TW/es/it/ja/pt-BR）；写操作受只读、allowDelete 与两阶段确认保护，并提供 11 个 MCP 工具供 AI 自动化调用。
